what: Description of the Groth16/BN128 demo circuit shipped in backend/src/data/zkp_circuit. Not read by application code.
circuitStatement: a * b == product (2 private inputs, 1 public output; public.json carries 3 signals)
roleInProduct: Library self-test for snarkjs verification in backend/tests/zkp_verification.test.ts. The product does not generate proofs and no proof is bound to a clinical record. Record integrity is provided by Ed25519 signatures over canonical JSON and SHA-256 hash chains (backend/src/security, backend/src/services/zkProof.service.ts).
relationToPatent: None. The pending application (Indian 202531095594, priority 5 Oct 2025; PCT/IN2026/052065, filed 5 Oct 2026; 21 claims) concerns routing encrypted vector-similarity operations between homomorphic encryption and hardware enclaves across peer nodes. Its claim 18 requires a zero-knowledge proof over the similarity computation executed in an enclave; this demo circuit is not that.
